msg: The colour of the gnome determines whether you get more or less mushrooms, but this doesn't always stay the same. There are pairs of colours, like yellow is always with red, and sometimes one will give more mushrooms than the other. If you get 3 or less on a certain colour, try the other colour in the pair next time. If you get 5 or more mushrooms on a certain colour, keep picking that colour when the pair comes up. Keep in mind, sometimes the colour that gives you more mushrooms switches during the game.
